one_line: A questionnaire-based survey of 52 Serbian manufacturing organizations (food processing and non-metallic mineral products) assessing ISO 50001 energy-management implementation via the PDCA cycle; continuous-flow sectors (steel, cement, petroleum, paper, glass) appear only in literature, emission tables, or as questionnaire sector options.
